$Comment: The game's own Winter Lights on the festival shelf, priced in festival tokens. Dates puts them on sale from November 20 to January 6 every year, both days in and counted in UTC, and keeps them off the shelf (hidden, not locked) the rest of the year, so Martha's Harvest Feast stall carries them and Old Jack's Hallow's Eve stall never does. The title is the item's own name key, written in full (server.items.<Id>.name) so the shelf shows the name the item shows in the bag; the item has no description key, so the offer has no line under it.
